title: Space Invaders
native_title: スペース・インベーダー
overview:
1978, the game world was hot... Sweeping all of Japan into a whirlpool of excitement, it arrived! Its name: Space Invaders!!

Breaking years of silence, the Invaders shake up the game world at the end of the century! New-generation gamers, behold the depth of the origin of games! Former kings of the game cafes, remember those half-forgotten days of passion!!

Unadjusted, additive-free original!
Enjoy four nostalgic types of graphics! Which one is your origin!?

Even more fun with Versus Mode!
A heated battle mode! Games are war!!

Rows of aliens march back and forth across the screen, stepping lower each time they reach the edge and speeding up as their numbers fall. Slide your laser cannon left and right, fire one shot at a time, and hide behind the bunkers while you pick them off. Shoot down the passing UFO for bonus points, and stop the invaders before they reach the ground.

- Original Game: the arcade classic with monochrome, cellophane overlay, color and background screen styles, plus adjustable lives, extend score and starting round
- 2P Battle: split-screen head-to-head play where your missed shots cross over into your rival's field and colored special invaders can wipe out a row or push the opponent's formation down

1978年、ゲーム界は熱かった・・・
日本中を興奮の渦に巻き込み、それはやってきた！
その名もスペースインベーダー!!

長年の沈黙を破り、インベーダーたちが世紀末ゲーム界に揺さぶりをかける！新世代ゲーマーたちよ、ゲームの原点の底深さを見よ！元ゲーム喫茶の帝王たちよ、忘れかけた情熱の日々を思い出せ!!

成分無調整、無添加オリジナル！
なつかしい4タイプのグラフィックが楽しめる！君の原点はどれだ!?

対戦モードでさらに面白い！
白熱するバトルモード！ゲームは戦いだ!!
